name: evervault-card
title: Evervault Card
description: A circular badge with a single word sits on black; moving the pointer over it unveils a green-to-blue radial glow and a dense scramble of tiny characters that follows the cursor.
use: A small hero badge or status disc needs a showy, techy hover reveal.
avoid: The cue must work on touch, or the screen has to stay calm and readable.
a11y: The reveal is pointer-only with no keyboard route, and the character layer regenerates on every move with no reduced-motion check. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A thin bordered card with small plus marks at its corners holds a black field and a dark round disc carrying the word hover in white. Around the disc a soft green-to-blue wash and columns of tiny monospaced characters spread outward; below sit two grey caption lines and a small outlined pill.
behaves: At rest only the black disc and its word are visible. Moving the pointer exposes a 250px radial spotlight of green-to-blue and randomised characters around the disc, following the cursor and reshuffling the text on every move; leaving fades it back to black.
customise: text sets the word inside the disc and className styles the wrapper. The 1500-character noise, the green-blue palette and the 250px spotlight radius are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A few layered divs plus 1500 characters of text regenerated on each pointer move.
demo: Badge word "hover" with the caption "Hover over this card to reveal an awesome effect" and a Watch me hover pill.
issues: The reveal is pointer-only, so touch and keyboard users never see the effect.
The caption and pill come from the demo, so the component alone is only the disc and word.
polishWhy: Striking character spotlight on a clean glass badge; pointer-only reveal keeps it short of five.
